from graphlib import TopologicalSorter

diamond = {"a": [], "b": ["a"], "c": ["a"], "d": ["b", "c"]}
flat = {"x": [], "y": [], "z": []}

def count_waves(graph):
    ts = TopologicalSorter(graph)
    ts.prepare()
    waves = 0
    while ts.is_active():
        ready = ts.get_ready()
        waves += 1
        ts.done(*ready)
    return waves

print(count_waves(diamond))
print(count_waves(flat))
